name: Media mould
doc: A slime mould (physarum agents) feeding on the picture: agents smell its bright areas (core-media's luma) as food and its contours (edges) as walls, lay trails that carry the picture's own colours, and grow a web of veins that redraws it; the picture glows dimly underneath and comes back at every phrase start, when part of the colony respawns on its brightest spots. Bass stretches the sensors and the appetite, mids widen them, loudness speeds the agents, and every onset drops a bloom of spores on a bright spot and flashes the veins.

in.doc: the picture: the colours the trails carry and the dim backdrop (core-media.out)

luma.doc: food: the agents steer toward bright areas and respawn there (core-media.luma)

edges.doc: walls: hard contours push the agents away (core-media.edges)

palette.doc: tints the thick veins and their glow

cells.doc: trail map height in cells (width follows the aspect)

angle.doc: sensor angle in degrees (mids widen it)

reach.doc: sensor distance in cells at 540 (bass stretches it)

speed.doc: move per step in cells at 540 (loudness and onsets add to it)

food.doc: pull of the picture's bright areas against the scent of the trail (bass adds to it)

wall.doc: push away from the picture's hard contours

react.doc: how much the music bends the sensors, the appetite and the speed

burst.doc: share of the agents respawned as spores on each onset (0 = off)

reform.doc: share respawned on bright spots at each phrase start, and how far the picture comes back then

tint.doc: palette colour in the veins (0 = the picture's colours only)

sat.doc: saturation of the colours the veins carry

exposure.doc: tone-map gain on the trail density
